preconditions.description: The number of photos on the widget must be between 3 and 1000.
The number of albums must be between 1 and 40.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 1000 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each album must contain between 1 and 1000 photos.

postconditions.description: If there is no solution, the output must be '-1'. Otherwise, the output must contain exactly n numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ti <= m for ti in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each number in the output must represent a valid album number between 1 and m.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] != return_value[(i + 1) % n] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: No two consecutive photos in the output can be from the same album.
